parallels.note: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

translations.web: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
translations.bsb: The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
translations.kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
translations.asv: And they ate, and were filled: and they took up, of broken pieces that remained over, seven baskets.
